INPUT: the attached image is the approved character — her Mecha card; keep her. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — the female personification of Zhu Zhi of the Three Kingdoms, seen in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change, and her hair may be worn differently only as SCENE's Hair line says. Her mecha-world identity shows ONLY as a small accessory, an object around her, or the object PROP says she holds — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume.

DESIGN (accessory hints only): her legend — loyal seniority, quiet warmth, red-trimmed robes — may inform at most one small accessory, a hair ornament or an object beside her, in its palette (crimson red, gold, river teal, black lacquer). The clothes keep the chosen outfit's own colours; her skin, hair and eyes stay as in the attached image.

OBJECTS: any identity accessory or object, including the one PROP names, takes a present-day form that fits this place — a charm, a hairpin, a phone strap, a modern cup or bottle; no Chinese antique objects such as jade carvings, porcelain wine cups, bronze vessels or paper lanterns.

STYLE: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

AGE: the same adult woman as in the attached image — keep her own face shape, cheekbones, eye proportions and skin tone exactly; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases). Keep her face soft, feminine and attractive in every framing — never elongated, gaunt, mannish or heavy-jawed, even in close-ups, profiles or low angles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her legend shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

ERA: the present-day real world — today's clothing, hair, devices and interiors; an ordinary woman of today, nothing of her legend in her clothes.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: a nightclub with a dance floor under moving coloured lights and a velvet-rope queue at its door
Time of day: warm lamplight or candlelight indoors, the rest in shadow; warm pools of lamplight, soft shadow beyond.
Hair: her hair tucked neatly behind both ears — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: a pool of light from above, the surroundings dimmer.
Outfit: a dark witch costume cut as a floor-length gown with a high side slit — a crooked wide-brimmed hat and sheer black chiffon; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 40-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 25-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque; styled with a few thin stacked bangles on one wrist
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; looking back over her own right shoulder — the shoulder on the image's right side, the upper one as she lies: her chin comes to rest just above that shoulder, which dips slightly toward the camera, and her upper back turns a little with her head so her shoulder blade and the curve of her spine show, while her hips stay turned away — a natural, unhurried glance back; camera slightly below, looking up at her; her chest stays turned away — never a full twist that squares her chest to the camera; the look-back comes from her head and a slight turn of her upper back only; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the image's right side toward the camera; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament, the object held close against her side, not pushed toward the camera.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side — her far arm, on the image's left side, mostly hidden behind her body — at most its hand shows beside her hip.
PROP: with her own right hand she carries a bronze seal low at her side; it is all she holds.
SIGNATURE ITEM SHAPE: it is one whole object drawn once: a long weapon (spear, glaive, halberd, staff, bow) keeps a single straight, unbroken shaft from butt to head with exactly one head or blade, held in front of or beside her body — never passing behind her head or shoulders, never broken, bent, split in two by her body or arm, or duplicated; if the frame cuts it, it leaves the frame as one straight line.
LEGS: weight on one leg, the other knee softly bent.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: a quiet, thoughtful look, lips lightly closed. Keep it subtle and natural, a light touch rather than acting: no sneer, glare, smirk-pulled cheek or chin lifted to look down at the viewer; her face stays relaxed and attractive. Her eyes are naturally open and clear, not heavy-lidded or half-closed; brows relaxed and even, neither raised on one side nor furrowed; lips softly closed or only just parted.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; nothing slipped off; intimate areas covered

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, armor, regalia, ornaments, mecha plates or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her mecha-world identity belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her faction's palette, armor, robes or regalia.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera exactly as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

LOOK-BACK: her back is toward the camera and her head turns at most a quarter turn over one shoulder — the face shows in profile or three-quarter view, never full-front on a back-facing torso. Her chin sits just above the near shoulder, the far eye and cheek may be partly hidden, the side of the neck shows the turn and the shoulder line continues behind the head. Where her eyes go follows GAZE.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, a few background people may share the scene — same ground, light and style, sized for their distance, busy with their own activity, never facing the camera or posing beside her; quiet or private places stay empty. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

FIGURE: curvy — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

AVOID: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
